paraphrase: Root downfalls of kings, ministers and beginner bodhisattvas — among them teaching emptiness to the unprepared, turning others from the great vehicle, abandoning the prātimokṣa, disparaging the śrāvaka vehicle — and their confession to Ākāśagarbha, who appears in dreams.
